幽谷谷口，毒草丛生，蛊气滔天。

数条墨黑巨型毒蛊盘踞草间，身躯粗如手臂，鳞片泛着幽绿毒光，獠牙外露，口涎滴落地面，腐蚀出滋滋白烟。察觉到生人靠近，它们猛地抬起头颅，发出低沉嘶鸣，死死盯住小队众人，蓄势待发。

崖壁咒纹发黑流转，源源不断往外宣泄毒瘴阴气，滋养整片山林迷魂蛊阵。幽谷深处，雾气重重，隐约有数道黑影隐匿蛰伏，气息阴诡，正是九菊养蛊师、阴阳师与甲贺忍者埋伏在此。

“动手！”

胡九郎一声低喝，身形率先掠出，踏入谷口迷雾之中。

他指尖翻飞，数张朱砂符箓凌空铺开，赤红光纹交织，化作一道镇蛊符网，笼罩整片谷口上空。符网灵光垂落，压制周遭躁动的蛊毒气息，让地面巨型毒蛊动作瞬间迟缓几分。

范梦雪紧随其后，素白道袍无风自动，周身银白雷光暴涨，神霄雷法全力催动。

“雷落驱蛊，净化邪瘴！”

咔嚓！

天际隐有雷鸣暗动，数道雷弧顺着她指尖劈落，精准轰向盘踞谷口的巨型毒蛊。

雷光至阳至刚，天生克制阴蛊毒瘴。

雷弧砸中毒蛊身躯的瞬间，黑烟滚滚，毒蛊发出凄厉嘶鸣，黝黑躯体瞬间焦黑开裂，体内剧毒被雷力强行灼烧挥发，挣扎片刻便瘫倒在地，彻底失去生机。

一条、两条、三条……

片刻之间，数条巨型毒蛊尽数被雷法灭杀，化作满地焦黑残骸，林间蛊腥气息稍稍淡去几分。

谷中暗处，一道身着九菊诡异服饰的女子身影缓缓走出。

女子面色惨白，眉眼阴柔，身着绣满蛊虫纹路的黑衣，袖口、裙摆藏着无数细小蛊囊，周身萦绕浓稠黑雾，蛊气逼人，眼神冷漠怨毒，死死盯着众人。

正是九菊一派的中级养蛊师，织田美子。

“中土修士，好大的胆子。”女子声音阴冷生硬，带着异域腔调，“敢闯我九菊蛊阵，杀我驯养凶蛊，今日，全都葬身蛊瘴之中！”

她抬手轻轻一拍袖袍，无数细小黑蛊从蛊囊中飞出，漫天飞舞，如同黑云般朝着众人席卷而来。这些蛊虫体型细小，数量成千上万，沾身即腐，入体噬脉，凶险无比。

“早就等着你的蛊虫！”

钱丹缓步踏出，苗疆衣裙轻扬，袖中飞出数十只雪白清心蛊、噬毒蛊。

白蛊浮空成团，散发出柔和白光，化作一道光墙挡在前方。

白蛊天生克制黑蛊毒瘴，漫天黑蛊撞上白光屏障，瞬间成片萎靡、僵死，如同雪花遇烈火，根本无法逾越半步。

苗疆正统医蛊对上九菊邪蛊，天生压制，高下立判。

At the mouth of the deep valley, there are overgrown poisonous weeds, and the poisonous aura is overwhelming.

Several giant black poisonous poisonous insects were entrenched in the grass. Their bodies were as thick as arms, their scales glowed with green poisonous light, their fangs were exposed, and their saliva dripped onto the ground, corroding into white smoke.Sensing the approach of strangers, they suddenly raised their heads, let out a low hiss, and stared at the team, preparing to attack.

The curse patterns on the cliff are black and flowing, and the poisonous miasma is constantly venting outwards, nourishing the entire mountain forest's ecstasy Gu formation.Deep in the valley, there is heavy mist, and there are several dark shadows hiding and dormant, with sinister auras. It is the Jiuju Gu Master, the Onmyoji and the Koga Ninja who are ambushing here.

"Do it!"

Hu Jiulang shouted low and took the lead in stepping out into the mist at the mouth of the valley.

His fingertips flew, and several cinnabar talismans spread out in the air. The red light patterns intertwined and turned into a poison-suppressing talisman network, covering the entire valley entrance.The aura of the talisman net falls, suppressing the restless poisonous atmosphere around it, causing the giant poisonous poison on the ground to move a little slower instantly.

Fan Mengxue followed closely behind, her plain white Taoist robe moved automatically without any wind, the silvery white lightning around her body surged, and Shenxiao's thunder method was activated with all its strength.

"Thunder falls to drive away the poison and purify the evil miasma!"

Click!

There was faint thunder in the sky, and several thunder arcs fell along her fingertips, accurately hitting the giant poisonous poison entrenched at the mouth of the valley.

The light of thunder is as strong as the yang, and naturally restrains the poisonous miasma of yin poison.

The moment the thunder arc hit the poisonous Gu's body, black smoke billowed, and the poisonous Gu let out a shrill scream. The dark body was instantly blackened and cracked. The poison in the body was forcibly burned and volatilized by the thunder. After struggling for a moment, he collapsed to the ground, completely losing his life.

One, two, three...

In a moment, all the giant poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous poisonous creatures were killed by lightning, turning into charred remains all over the ground. The poisonous poisonous poisonous smell in the forest faded slightly.

In the darkness of the valley, a female figure wearing Jiuju's strange costume slowly walked out.

The woman's face was pale, her eyebrows were soft, and she was dressed in black clothes embroidered with poisonous patterns. There were countless small poisonous sacs hidden in her sleeves and skirt. She was surrounded by thick black mist, and her poisonous energy was overwhelming. Her eyes were cold and hateful, and she stared at everyone.

It was none other than Oda Miko, the intermediate Gu master of the Jiuju sect.

"Chinese-earth monk, you are so courageous." The woman's voice was cold and stiff, with an exotic accent, "If you dare to break into my Nine Chrysanthemum Gu Formation and kill me to tame the vicious Gu, you will all be killed by the Gu Miasma today!"

She raised her hand and patted her sleeves gently, and countless tiny black poisons flew out from the poison bag, flying all over the sky, sweeping towards everyone like black clouds.These Gu insects are small in size and number in the tens of thousands. They will rot if they touch the body, and they will devour the veins of the body. They are extremely dangerous.

"The Gu insect has been waiting for you for a long time!"

Qian Dan stepped out slowly, Miao Jiang's dress fluttered slightly, and dozens of snow-white pure heart Gu and poison-eating Gu flew out from his sleeves.

White Gu floated into a ball, emitting a soft white light, turning into a wall of light blocking the front.

White Gu is naturally capable of restraining the poisonous miasma of black Gu. The black Gu in the sky collided with the white light barrier and instantly became sluggish and dead, like snowflakes encountering fire, unable to cross even half a step.

Miaojiang's orthodox medical Gu is naturally suppressive to Jiuju's evil Gu, and makes judgments between superiors and superiors.
